headline: Norris keeps a cool head through a disrupted race in Zandvoort
standfirst: Lando Norris won the Dutch Grand Prix for McLaren, finishing 11.536s ahead of Kimi Antonelli, with George Russell completing the podium after 72 laps of Zandvoort.

sections.title: The start
sections.body: Lando Norris lined up first on the grid. Norris converted that into the lead at the end of lap one. The biggest winner of the opening lap was Colapinto, up 4 places to 10th.

sections.title: How it unfolded
sections.body: The lead changed hands 6 times. Laps led: Antonelli (32), Norris (31) and Hamilton (9). Norris took the lead for good on lap 54. The race was neutralised by 1 red flag (lap 2).

sections.title: Strategy
sections.body: Norris made 2 stops, running medium → soft → hard tyres. The field made 44 pit stops in total; the quickest stationary time was 2.2s for Stroll on lap 35. 1 of the top 10 finishers got home with one stop or fewer.

sections.title: Movers
sections.body: Fernando Alonso made up the most ground, climbing 9 places from 18th to 9th. Bortoleto went the other way, slipping from 9th to 13th. Timing recorded 292 on-track position changes, 33 of them by Lindblad.

sections.title: Retirements
sections.body: Albon (lap 67), Verstappen (lap 1), Stroll (lap 46), Ocon (lap 53), Bottas (lap 62) and Bearman (lap 3) failed to finish.

sections.title: Conditions and pace
sections.body: It stayed dry throughout. Track temperature ranged from 30°C to 38°C, with air at 18–20°C. Arvid Lindblad set the fastest lap, a 55.274 on lap 4.
